description: Verify add-issue --from-json creates and activates an issue in a fresh temp repo, and duplicate issue IDs are blocked.
setup_commands: kajiya-build-line init-project --project-id temp-from-json-test --project-name "Temp From JSON Test" --project-type software_project

content_json.title: Temp issue from JSON
content_json.problem: Need to verify add-issue --from-json works without long CLI args.
content_json.expected_behavior: The command creates and activates a backlog item from JSON.

assertions.description: The issue is activated in current-project.
Second add-issue call blocks duplicate issue ID.

notes: This scenario was created from the manual temp repo test that caught the argparse required-fields bug in KBL-025.
A future deterministic scenario runner should execute this artifact and evaluate assertions.
